query_text: what is the funnest terraria class

content.text:
The **funnest Terraria class** is usually **Summoner** — especially in modern Terraria.

Why Summoner is so fun:
- You get an army of minions fighting for you.
- Whips make you feel active instead of just standing back.
- You can focus on dodging while your summons shred bosses.
- It has a very different playstyle from the other classes.
- Late-game Summoner with Stardust gear feels amazing.

That said, it depends on what you enjoy:

| Class | Fun factor |
|---|---|
| **Summoner** | Best if you like pets, chaos, and dodging |
| **Mage** | Best if you like flashy weapons and variety |
| **Ranger** | Best if you like consistent damage and guns/bows |
| **Melee** | Best if you like tankiness and close-range brawling |

My personal recommendation:  
**Play Summoner if you want the most unique/fun experience.**  
If you want the most flashy and varied class, choose **Mage**.
